A CAR THAT LOOKS OUT FOR YOU, LITERALLY
The TLX delivers a full suite of advanced, active safety and driver-
assistance technologies as standard equipment. We call that
suite AcuraWatch,™ a network of systems designed to increase
awareness and support the driver, working to help prevent, avoid,
and mitigate impacts.
AcuraWatch uses sensors that can continuously monitor the
vehicle’s surroundings, warning of potential threats, automatically
providing steering input to help keep you in the center of a detected
lane, automatically braking the vehicle when necessary to maintain
a set interval from a vehicle detected ahead and, when necessary,
emergency-braking to help avoid frontal collisions.
In addition, our available Surround-View Camera system gives
you a 360-degree view of the space around the TLX, which is
extremely helpful when backing into tight parking spaces. The
system also delivers a front wide-angle view that’s useful when
exiting garages, parking spaces, and alleys.4
